evidence.notes: Local Database.getUpdated returns IDs whose system-modified timestamp falls inside the requested sync window.
GetUpdatedResult exposes the matching local record IDs.
GetUpdatedResult carries the requested latest covered DateTime.

name: data-platform-database-updated-sync-window
salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce API 67 rejects Database.getUpdated(String, Datetime, Datetime) during compile; retain the deterministic local sync-window proof and record the hosted signature mismatch explicitly.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseUpdatedSyncWindowFixtureTest { @isTest static void updatedWindowReturnsMatchingIds() { Datetime startWindow = Datetime.now().addMinutes(-1); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Before'); insert account; account.Name = 'After'; update account; Datetime endWindow = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); Database.GetUpdatedResult inside = Database.getUpdated('Account', startWindow, endWindow); System.assert(inside.getIds().contains(account.Id)); System.assertNotEquals(null, inside.getLatestDateCovered()); Database.GetUpdatedResult outside = Database.getUpdated('Account', Datetime.now().addDays(-2), Datetime.now().addDays(-1)); System.assertEquals(0, outside.getIds().size()); } }
